text:
matt_b: Quick q — saw a customer hit 413s on the /embeddings route despite dims being small. They sent a few huge strings that compress poorly. Our routing currently uses dim-count for SLO decisions. Should we add a bytes-aware fallback?

anya: Yea saw that too. The preflight gives dims but we only check `X-Embed-Dims` for routing. No one is honoring payload bytes until later in the stack.

kevin: Can you paste the sample request?

matt_b: Here, sanitized: `Content-Length: 102400000`, `X-Embed-Dims: 512`, body: 10 long documents concatenated. Runtime rejected at splitter with 413.

shreya: This is an awkward edge: dim-based batching keeps perf predictable for typical usage, but bytes spikes can blow memory / cause OOMs in collectors. We should do a quick hybrid: prefer dims for normal flow, but if `Content-Length` > threshold then route to slowpath or early fail with clearer error.

jen: UX question for console: if we change behavior, how do we show this to users so they aren't surprised? They currently see "dims too large" errors even when bytes were the culprit.

anya: We could add a new telemetry tag `ingress_overage_reason: bytes|dims` and surface a short hint in the console route status. Eg: "Oversize request (by bytes). Consider chunking or using embed-chunk API."

kevin: For rollout, we should gate behind a feature flag per-tenant so enterprise customers can opt-in. Also add a soft-telemetry wave for 1% traffic to measure false positives.

matt_b: Agreed. Implementation sketch: 1) preflight middleware reads `Content-Length` (or `Transfer-Encoding`) 2) if bytes > BYTE_THRESHOLD and dims < DIM_THRESHOLD -> mark `overage_reason=bytes` and either route to `slowpath` or return `413 with body advising chunking` 3) record metric `embed.preflight.overage{reason}`.

shreya: What's a good BYTE_THRESHOLD? 10MB? 50MB? Our splitter memory is ~64MB per request if naive. I'd start with 25MB.

anya: 25MB sounds safe. Also add a console toggle under the Embeddings settings: "Bytes-aware preflight (beta)" with rollout % slider.

jen: For messaging in console, let's show: "Request rejected due to total payload size. Try batching or the chunked embeddings endpoint." Link to helpdoc. Also include an example curl showing `--data-binary` chunking.

kevin: Telemetry: we need histogram of `preflight.payload_bytes`, `preflight.dims` and counter `preflight.rejected{reason}`. Put these in the per-route dashboard and add an alert if rejections spike above baseline.

console-bot: deploy flag `embeds.bytes_preflight` created. Canary rollout automation available at `/console/flags/embeds.bytes_preflight`.

matt_b: Nice. Action items: (1) eng-platform implement preflight check + reason tag (kevin/shreya) (2) eng-console add toggle and UI hint + docs link (anya/jen) (3) metrics + alert (kevin) (4) rollout plan: start 1% -> 10% -> tenant opt-in.

anya: I'll draft the console copy and the helpdoc link: https://redwood.internal/docs/embeddings/oversize-howto -> include chunking example and SDK helper.

shreya: I'll start a PR for preflight. We'll keep the default behavior as return-413-with-help for the canary to avoid silent routing changes. After 2 weeks of telemetry we can enable soft-route-to-slowpath for selected tenants.

matt_b: Perfect. If anyone sees other oversize flavors (multipart or streaming) tag them here. Otherwise I'll put this in the weekly eng-platform sync. :thumbsup:
